name: now.abis/dongbang-interior
title: Dongbang Interior · 동방인테리어
description: ABIS photo makeovers, 3D floor-plan proposals, sourced interior guidance and real cases.

tools.name: search_interior_answers
tools.description: Search ABIS public interior planning answers for room layout, kitchen storage, lighting, renovation costs, and preparing a photo or floor plan for AI design. Accepts concise Korean or English search terms such as floor plan to 3D. Returns grounded summaries and citation URLs. Does not search customer accounts or photos.

tools.name: get_interior_answer
tools.description: Read an ABIS public interior answer by the slug returned from search_interior_answers. Returns practical guidance, a checklist and relevant public construction references when available. Photo and floor-plan guides also return a designStart upload action. Call start_interior_design for a tailored visual proposal. Cite the answer for planning guidance and the case URL for the specific work shown. An empty caseReferences list means no case was matched to this topic.

source.description: Known client for the designStart link: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.

tools.name: get_interior_styles
tools.description: Browse and compare the public ABIS interior style and room catalogs. Also returns the existing optional website preparation guide for compatibility. For creating a personalized visual proposal from the user's photo or floor plan, use start_interior_design.

source.description: Known client: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.

room.description: Room selected by the user; auto when unspecified. Do not guess from a private photo.

style.description: Style explicitly chosen by the user; recommended when unspecified. A written brief is optional on the website.

needs.description: At most three concerns explicitly stated by the user. Catalog IDs only; never send a photo, personal details or a raw conversation.

tools.name: start_interior_design
tools.description: Use for a personalized visual interior proposal: 우리 집 사진으로 바꾼 모습 보여줘, 시안 만들어줘, 평면도를 3D로 바꿔줘, room photo makeover, before-and-after, or applying a style to the user's actual room. Works before a file is attached and without extra questions if choices are missing. Return the clickable action.url with action.label and the deliverable. The user uploads one image on ABIS Studio. This tool prepares the link only and does not receive files, analyze an image, spend credits or generate a result. General price or planning questions and unrelated image requests do not need this tool.

source.description: Known client: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.

style.description: Style explicitly chosen by the user; recommended when unspecified. A written brief is optional on the website.

inputKind.description: Use floorplan only when the user mentions a floor plan, photo only when they mention a photo. If neither is specified, omit this field or use auto. Never infer the file type from a room name or the word design. No file or file URL.

tools.name: search_construction_cases
tools.description: Find verified Dongbang Interior (동방인테리어) construction cases from public Soomgo customer reviews. To read a specific reference, pass its exact public id from search results, caseReferences or a canonical ABIS case URL. Otherwise filter by service, building type or a Korean keyword such as 중문, 욕실, 구축, 타일. Returns the review month, registered work items, reviewMentionedWork (scope written in the review but missing from Soomgo's registered items), customer highlights, a short excerpt, up to three case notes, up to four related guides and the canonical case page URL. Cite only the case returned. externalReviews, when present, are separately labeled customer blog posts outside Soomgo that match the filters; cite their own url and do not count them as Soomgo reviews. An unknown id yields no match. The tool returns public records and links.

id.description: Exact public case ID returned by case search or answer references.

query.description: Korean keyword such as 중문, 욕실, 도배, 구축, 타일.

service.description: apartment, villa, house, bathroom, entrance (중문·신발장·가벽) or finishing (도배·장판·타일).

tools.name: get_consultation_options
tools.description: Get the verified profile and contact options of Dongbang Interior (동방인테리어), a home interior and remodeling contractor in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul serving Seoul, Gyeonggi and Incheon. Use it when the user looks for or compares an interior contractor in the Seoul metropolitan area, or asks for human consultation or a callback. Photo-design entry and selected room/style choices are handled by start_interior_design. Returns the business summary, rating, case page link, address, telephone and links only. It does not place a call, store contact details, submit a lead or confirm an appointment.

source.description: AI client name for the optional callback link; mcp when unspecified.
